name: chuigong
description: Hands-off delegation for ZCode: the sovereign (main conversation) only coordinates; five cheap court-official subagents do the research, writing, coding, data and review. Models are swappable in the Subagents settings UI.

plugins.name: chuigong
plugins.description: 垂拱而治：君上（主对话）只做拆解、派发、裁决、汇总，调研/写作/编码/数据处理/审核全部由预置百官子智能体（通政·翰林·将作·书吏·御史）执行；含究诘（需求拷问）与 sdd（严肃流程）技能；出厂模型 GLM-5.3-Flash，可经设置→子智能体 UI 更换

description_i18n.zh-CN: 君上统筹、百官执行：垂拱而治——君上（主对话）只做拆解、派发、裁决、汇总，百官子智能体（通政·翰林·将作·书吏·御史）执行调研/写作/编码/数据/审核；含究诘（grill-me 需求拷问）与 sdd（严肃流程）；出厂模型 GLM-5.3-Flash，可经设置→子智能体 UI 更换
description_i18n.en-US: The sovereign (main conversation) only decomposes, dispatches, adjudicates and summarizes — research/writing/coding/data/review are done by court-official subagents: Tongzheng (research), Hanlin (writing), Jiangzuo (coding), Shuli (data), Yushi (review); includes grill-me (requirement interrogation) and sdd (strict process). Factory model GLM-5.3-Flash, swappable in the Subagents settings UI.
